schemaVersion.description: Contract version. The game reads the versions in config feeds[feed].versions. Additive fields do not bump it; renames, unit changes and removals do.

generatedAt.description: When the backend wrote the file.

validUntil.description: After this a live feed counts as stale: in live mode its values ease to neutral. Required on live feeds in live data; optional on static tables.

source.description: "sample", or the backend’s own label (e.g. "db:weather/v2"). Audit only; never shown.

sample.description: True for hand-made data. Live mode refuses a file marked sample unless it is a preset table (config feeds[f].defaultInLive) (decision 4).

bundleRevision.description: The publication this file belongs to; must equal the manifest’s.

id.description: Stable key. Fades, audio voices, dissolve seeds and per-device memory key on it. Unique within the feed.

revision.description: Whole number that rises whenever the row changes (diffing, cache-busting, precedence ties).

sample.description: True for hand-made data. Must be true in every sample file; must be false in live data.

method.description: How the preset was chosen upstream, e.g. "weaviate-hybrid+rules".

confidence01.description: A calibrated classification confidence, 0–1. Only when calibrated: Weaviate distances and hybrid scores rank candidates and are not probabilities, so they stay upstream (R14). Below minConfidence01 (config) the game uses the category default.

classification.description: How the preset ids in this record were chosen upstream.

tags.description: Free labels from the backend; the game ignores them.

rightsRef.description: Rights note for any recorded sound or authored asset the record names (the owner's own recordings only).

endAt.description: End instant, ISO 8601 with offset; after startAt.

anyOf.description: Also checked: endAt is after startAt.

to.description: Closes at, Sydney time. At or before `from` it passes midnight; the window belongs to the weekday it starts on (Sat 22:00–02:00 is Saturday’s). Equal to `from` = 24 hours.

weekdays.description: Start weekdays, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Absent = every day.

anchor.description: The real sun event for the Sydney date (SKY1).

offsetMin.description: Start, minutes after the anchor (negative = before).

onShare.description: On while at least this share of the city's lamps is on (0–1; lamps follow sun elevation).

offAt.description: Switch-off, Sydney time. Before 12:00 it is the next morning; from 12:00 the same evening.

periodSec.description: Repeats every this many seconds of game time.

durationSec.description: On for this long each period, seconds.

offsetSec.description: First start, seconds of game time.

when.description: When a record is active. Wall-clock forms are Sydney local time (Australia/Sydney). 'sim' is a demo timer on the game clock, allowed only in sample records and never shown as a real listing.

edgeMetres.description: Blend width at the edge, metres (weights fade in over it).

ring.description: Closed ring of [lng, lat] points: the last point repeats the first.

edgeMetres.description: Blend width at the edge, metres (weights fade in over it).

anyOf.description: Also checked: the ring is closed (last point = first) and does not cross itself.

kind.description: A walkable line: promenades, arrival and dispersal paths.

line.description: The line, [lng, lat] points in walking order.

widthMetres.description: Width of the walkable band, metres.

heightRef.description: Datum of heightMetres: 'ground' (above the surface there) or 'sea' (above sea level). Default ground.

eventId.description: An event id or series id: from the events feed in live mode, from public/events/events.json in demo mode.

where.description: Where a record applies. Coordinates are WGS84 degrees.
